- ν₃ = 20,320 cm⁻¹

$$\nu_1 = 10Dq = 9,180 \text{ cm}^{-1}$$
$$Dq = 918 \text{ cm}^{-1}$$

$$20,320 = 15B + 10(918)$$
$$20,320 = 15B + 9,180$$
$$15B = 11,140$$
